title.narrative: Prepare and plan the German market entry for WOO

description.narrative: GWI wants to improve and expand its existing value chain of luxury home fragrances and candles in Vietnam. GWI/WOO defines itself as ‘a social enterprise that creates a premium lifestyle brand that mobilizes andconnects privileged and conscious consumers with underprivileged or vulnerable communities’. GWI has approached the RVO for support in terms of preparing its organization for scaling up its value-chained business, both in terms of production as well as in terms of building the retail organization. To be able to scale up the business the coming years, the company needs to expand its sales in Europe. In the Netherlands the products are received well and the sales are promising. As a next step the company identified Germany as a large potential market for its products. The TA helps the entrepreneur to establish a niche market for its products in Germany. A larger sales volume will generate cash flow necessary to scale and professionalise the value chain and production unit. Together with the high risk, high impact loan the TA guarantees the sustainability and impact of the business and investments in Vietnam.
